parts.name: Fan Blades
parts.Basic_description: These are the rotating blades of the ceiling fan, typically made of aluminum for lightweight and durability.
parts.Functional_description: The fan blades are responsible for circulating air when the motor rotates them, creating airflow in the room.
parts.Movement_description: They rotate around the central axis driven by the motor, converting electrical energy into mechanical motion.

parts.name: Base Body
parts.Basic_description: This is the main body and mounting structure of the ceiling fan, made of steel for strength and stability.
parts.Functional_description: It houses the motor and supports the fan blades, connecting them to the ceiling mount for secure installation.
parts.Movement_description: It remains stationary while supporting the rotating blades and internal motor components.
